goal.en: Use rhythm, repetition and contrast so a sentence lands rather than merely informs.
goal.ar: أن توظّف الإيقاع والتكرار والتقابل لتصل الجملة إلى القارئ لا لتخبره فحسب.

text.en: Items in a list should share a grammatical shape. When they do, the reader stops noticing the sentence and starts noticing the argument.
text.ar: ينبغي أن تتشارك عناصر القائمة الشكل النحوي نفسه. فإذا فعلت، كفّ القارئ عن ملاحظة الجملة وبدأ يلاحظ الحجّة.

head: Broken
Parallel
rows: We need to cut costs, hiring staff and a new system.
We need to cut costs, hire staff and buy a system.
She is clever, hard-working and gets on with people.
She is clever, hard-working and personable.
The plan is bold, it is cheap, and risky too.
The plan is bold, cheap and risky.

text.en: Three is the number that sounds finished. Two feels like a comparison; four begins to feel like a list you are enduring.
text.ar: الثلاثة عدد يوحي بالاكتمال. فالاثنان يبدوان مقارنة، والأربعة تبدأ في الإحساس بأنها قائمة تُحتمل.

head: Pattern
Example
rows: The problem is not the cost but the delay.
One team shipped early, whereas the other is still planning.
It is less a policy than an aspiration.
Ambition without a timetable is a wish.

text.en: Antithesis works because the two halves are built the same way. Break the symmetry and the contrast blurs.
text.ar: ينجح التقابل لأن الشطرين مبنيان على النسق نفسه، فإذا كُسر التماثل تلاشى التضاد.

text.en: Do not force it. A false antithesis — “this is not a cost, it is an investment” — sounds clever and often hides that both are true.
text.ar: لا تتكلّفه. فالتقابل الزائف مثل «هذه ليست تكلفة بل استثمار» يبدو ذكياً ويُخفي غالباً أن الأمرين صحيحان معاً.

text.en: A page of sentences all the same length reads as a drone, however correct each one is. Vary the length, and put the short sentence where you want the reader to stop.
text.ar: الصفحة التي تتساوى فيها أطوال الجمل تُقرأ رتيبة مهما كانت كل جملة صحيحة. فنوّع الأطوال، وضع الجملة القصيرة حيث تريد أن يتوقف القارئ.

items.en: We spent four months rebuilding the process, retraining the staff and rewriting every template we had. None of it worked.
items.ar: أمضينا أربعة أشهر في إعادة بناء العملية وتدريب الموظفين وإعادة كتابة كل نموذج لدينا. لم ينفع شيء من ذلك.

items.en: It is late, over budget and badly documented. But it works.
items.ar: إنه متأخر ومتجاوز للميزانية وسيّئ التوثيق. لكنه يعمل.

text.en: The short sentence gets its force from the long one before it. Two short sentences in a row spend the effect; a page of them is a different problem.
text.ar: الجملة القصيرة تستمد قوّتها من الطويلة قبلها. فجملتان قصيرتان متتاليتان تستنفدان الأثر، وصفحة كاملة منهما مشكلة أخرى.

prompt.ar: أي جملة تكسر التوازي في البناء؟

options: We need to cut costs, hiring staff and a new system.
We need to cut costs, hire staff and buy a new system.
We need lower costs, more staff and a better system.
We need to reduce costs, recruit staff and upgrade systems.

explanation.en: An infinitive, a gerund and a noun phrase cannot share one list.
explanation.ar: لا يجتمع في قائمة واحدة مصدرٌ صريح واسم فاعل وعبارة اسمية.

prompt.en: Which description of a candidate is best built?

options: She is clever, hard-working and easy to work with.
She is clever, hard-working and gets on with people.
She is clever, a hard worker and works well with others.
She is clever and hard-working, also good with people.

explanation.en: Three adjectival phrases in the same shape; the others mix adjectives with clauses.
explanation.ar: ثلاث عبارات وصفية على نسق واحد، أما البقية فتخلط الصفات بالجمل.

prompt.en: Why do three parallel items sound finished?
prompt.ar: لماذا توحي العناصر الثلاثة المتوازية بالاكتمال؟

options: Two reads as a comparison and four as an unfinished list.
Three is the maximum a reader can remember at once.
Three items are always more accurate than two.
English grammar requires lists of three or more.

explanation.en: It is a rhythmic convention, not a rule — but it is a convention readers feel.
explanation.ar: إنه عرف إيقاعي لا قاعدة، لكنه عرف يحسّه القارئ.

prompt.en: Make it parallel: “The plan is bold, it is cheap, and risky too.” → “The plan is bold, cheap and ___ .”
prompt.ar: اجعلها متوازية: The plan is bold, cheap and ___

explanation.en: Three adjectives, one shape, no repeated verb. The sentence loses four words and gains force.
explanation.ar: ثلاث صفات بنسق واحد بلا تكرار للفعل. تفقد الجملة أربع كلمات وتكسب قوة.

questions.sentence: The problem is ___ the cost but the delay.
options: not
no
neither
hardly

explanation.en: “Not X but Y” is the standard antithesis frame, and both halves must be built alike.
explanation.ar: تركيب not X but Y هو الإطار المعتاد للتقابل، ويجب أن يُبنى الشطران على نسق واحد.

options: Ambition without a timetable is only a wish.
Ambition, if you have no timetable, is a wish really.
Ambition is a wish when a timetable is not there.
Having ambition but no timetable means it is a wish.

explanation.en: Short, balanced, and the weight falls on the last word — which is where English puts it.
explanation.ar: قصيرة متوازنة، ويقع الثقل على الكلمة الأخيرة، وهناك تضعه الإنجليزية.

prompt.en: “This is not a cost, it is an investment.” What does this construction hide?

options: That it can be both at the same time.
That the amount of money is very small.
That the speaker opposes the spending.
That the investment has already failed.

explanation.en: A false antithesis presents two compatible things as alternatives, and the symmetry does the persuading.
explanation.ar: التقابل الزائف يعرض أمرين متوافقين على أنهما بديلان، والتماثل هو ما يقوم بالإقناع.

prompt.en: Match the pattern with an example.

pairs: Not the cost, but the delay.
Less a policy than a hope.

explanation.en: Each frame sharpens a contrast the reader might otherwise skim past.
explanation.ar: كل إطار يُحدّ تقابلاً كان القارئ سيمرّ عليه مروراً.

prompt.en: Which pair uses sentence length to best effect?
prompt.ar: أي زوج يوظّف طول الجملة بأفضل أثر؟

options: We rebuilt the process, retrained the staff and rewrote every template. None of it worked.
We rebuilt the process. We retrained the staff. We rewrote every template. It failed.
We rebuilt the process and retrained the staff and rewrote every template and it failed.
Having rebuilt the process and retrained the staff, the templates were rewritten in vain.

explanation.en: The long sentence builds the effort; the short one demolishes it. That contrast is the point.
explanation.ar: الجملة الطويلة تبني الجهد، والقصيرة تهدمه، وهذا التقابل هو المقصود.

prompt.en: Where does a short sentence get its force from?
prompt.ar: من أين تستمد الجملة القصيرة قوّتها؟

options: From the longer sentence immediately before it.
From the number of syllables it contains.
From being placed at the start of a paragraph.
From using only words of one syllable.

explanation.en: Force is relative. A page of short sentences has no short sentences in the rhetorical sense.
explanation.ar: القوة نسبية. فصفحةٌ كلها جمل قصيرة لا تحوي جملة قصيرة بالمعنى البلاغي.

prompt.en: Which passage is weakest in rhythm?

options: The bid was late. The costing was wrong. The team was tired. We lost it.
The bid was late and badly costed, and the team was exhausted. We lost.
We lost the bid. It was late, badly costed, and the team was exhausted.
Late, badly costed and written by an exhausted team, the bid lost.

explanation.en: Four identical short sentences flatten into a drone — the same fault as four identical long ones.
explanation.ar: أربع جمل قصيرة متطابقة تتحول إلى رتابة، وهو عيب الجمل الطويلة المتطابقة نفسه.

prompt.en: All four are short. Which closing lands hardest after a long paragraph?
prompt.ar: الأربع قصيرة. أي خاتمة أشدّ وقعاً بعد فقرة طويلة؟

options: It changed nothing.
Nothing was changed.
No change occurred.
Change did not occur.

explanation.en: Length is equal, so the work is done by the verb: an active clause with a real subject beats a passive and two nominalisations.
explanation.ar: الأطوال متساوية، فالعمل هنا للفعل: جملة مبنية للمعلوم بفاعل حقيقي تتفوق على المجهول وعلى صيغتين اسميتين.

questions.answer: We came we listened and we changed nothing

explanation.en: Three parallel clauses, and the last one turns — the shape sets up the sting.
explanation.ar: ثلاث جمل متوازية تنعطف الأخيرة منها، والبناء هو ما يُعدّ للّسعة.

prompt.en: Sharpen the contrast: “The delay is the problem, not the cost.” Begin: “The problem is ___ the cost but the delay.”
prompt.ar: حدّ التقابل: The problem is ___ the cost but the delay.

explanation.en: “Not X but Y” puts the real subject last, where the emphasis falls.
explanation.ar: تركيب not X but Y يضع الموضوع الحقيقي في الآخر حيث يقع التركيز.

prompt.en: What is the risk of writing rhetorically in a technical report?
prompt.ar: ما خطر الكتابة البلاغية في تقرير تقني؟

options: A neat phrase can carry a claim the evidence does not support.
Readers cannot understand parallel structures in reports.
Short sentences are not permitted in technical writing.
Contrast structures always make a report longer to read.

explanation.en: Rhythm persuades independently of evidence, which is exactly why a careful reader distrusts it.
explanation.ar: الإيقاع يُقنع بمعزل عن الدليل، ولهذا بالذات يرتاب منه القارئ المتأني.
